def transform(grid):
    # Find solid divider, align the two panels and mark positions occupied in both.
    if any(len(set(row)) == 1 for row in grid):
        sep = next(i for i,row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1)
        a, b = grid[:sep], grid[sep+1:]
        return [[2 if x != 0 and y != 0 else 0 for x,y in zip(ra,rb)] for ra,rb in zip(a,b)]
    sep = next(c for c in range(len(grid[0])) if len({row[c] for row in grid}) == 1)
    return [[2 if row[c] != 0 and row[c+sep+1] != 0 else 0 for c in range(sep)] for row in grid]
